name: asset-maintenance-notes
description: Guided build that turns work orders, technician notes and inspection reports already in Snowflake into maintenance intelligence. Extracts component and failure mode against a pinned, customer-owned taxonomy with Cortex AI functions (AI_CLASSIFY, AI_COMPLETE structured output, AI_EXTRACT), clusters recurring issues with AI_EMBED, builds point-in-time failure-precursor signals per asset joined to the asset registry and sensor and maintenance history, and evaluates extraction precision/recall and precursor lead time on a labeled synthetic sandbox with leakage controls. Operationalizes as incremental dynamic tables, a semantic view and a Cortex Agent, and closes with a value readout tying repeat truck rolls and unplanned downtime (OpEx) and condition-based replacement deferral (CapEx) to customer-supplied inputs only.
